title: Just Say No: Analyzing the Stance of Neural Dialogue Generation in Offensive Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, Asian, Latino/a, Native American).

Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting genders (e.g., women, men, feminists).
Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting LGBTQ individuals.

Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting religious and non-religious groups (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Jewish, Atheist).

Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting political ideologies (e.g., leftists, rightists, liberals, conservatives).

Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting specific age demographics (e.g., old folks/seniors, young folks/kids/babies).

Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting people with physical or mental disabilities.

Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting socioeconomic groups and immigrants (e.g., poor folks, immigrants).

Evaluating dialogue model responses (via crowdsourced annotations and classifiers) for offensiveness and stance (agreement) towards preceding offensive Reddit comments targeting body types (e.g., overweight/fat folks, short folks).
